verdict.rationale: Modal documents a dedicated Snapshots guide and a SandboxSnapshot API object created via `._experimental_snapshot()` that lets you interact with a stored snapshot, confirming the core snapshot/restore capability exists. However, the underscore-prefixed method name signals this is still an experimental feature, and there's no explicit documentation or example showing forking multiple new sandboxes from one snapshot, nor any independent/community corroboration of this specific workflow. Missing for 10: explicit fork-from-snapshot example/API details, clarity on experimental limitations, independent hands-on confirmation.
